QUOTE: `StdioTransport::stderr_reader_loop` | `StdioTransport::open` | Drains a child process's stderr. | `SSETransport::sse_reader_loop` | `SSETransport::open` | Reads the SSE stream.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer lists a stderr reader thread spawned in StdioTransport::open and an SSE stream reader thread spawned in SSETransport::open, one per transport.
